channel.title: Brutal Diablo devlog
channel.description: How the bigger pieces of Brutal Diablo were made: the tech, the dead ends and what we learned.

item.title: The blood Diablo was meant to have
item.description: Diablo's makers wanted it gritty and gory. The game shipped with most of its blood painted into the floor of one room. We went back to that room to learn how they did it, then taught the engine to paint blood the same way, everywhere, as it happens.
